title: Timing of Late Funds and the Late-Fee Charge — Paystride Payroll Card Program Treasury Rule
content:
## Rule

For a Paystride Payroll Card Program, how the late-fee charge on a late regular payroll batch is figured follows when the batch's funds arrived, the batch's funding arrival being the latest entry date among the funding receipts booked for its pay date and the batch having posted late when its entry date is later than its pay date:

(i) for a batch that posted late, it is the greater of the package's late funding fee and 0.05 percent of the batch amount;

(ii) for a batch that posted on its pay date with its funding arrival on that same date, it is the package's late funding fee plus 15.00, the batch being loaded as a same-day load;

(iii) for any other late batch — funded after its deadline but before its pay date — the timing of the funds does not change how the charge is figured.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical, Elite package, late funding fee 0.00)

| Batch amount | Batch entry date against pay date | Funding arrival against pay date | Branch | Late-fee charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 142,380.00 | one business day later | the pay date | (i) | the greater of 0.00 and 71.19, that is 71.19 |
| 61,200.00 | one business day later | the pay date | (i) | the greater of 0.00 and 30.60, that is 30.60 |
| 88,400.00 | the pay date | the pay date | (ii) | 0.00 plus 15.00, that is 15.00 |
| 88,400.00 | the pay date | the day before the pay date | (iii) | no change from timing |

## Points of judgement

- The funding arrival is the latest of the entry dates of the funding receipts booked for that pay date; an earlier receipt for the same pay date does not set it.
- A batch whose entry date is later than its pay date falls under (i) whatever the funding arrival.
- The percent in (i) is 0.05 percent, that is five hundredths of one percent, of the batch amount.
